Scope: football, basketball and padel grounds, an air dome, a service and toilet building, landscape works, parking, and bike and walking paths at three sites: Hasa Oasis, the 2nd Industrial City at Arar and the 2nd Industrial City at Dammam.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. The project is at 65.70% against 67.16% planned, 1.45% behind the current plan (SPI 0.98). It gained 1.97% this week against 3.36% planned, so the weekly plan was missed by 1.39%. Hasa Oasis construction is still ahead (70.7% against 61.4% planned) but earned only a third of its planned man-hours this week, Arar construction is 3.3% behind, and procurement is 24.0% behind (71.3% against 95.2% planned).

Project completion is forecast 86 days late. The weekly report and the P6 update (data date 23-Nov-2026) both forecast completion on 29-Mar-2027, against the contract completion date of 02-Jan-2027. This is 7 days later than last week's forecast of 22-Mar-2027, the second slip of 7 days in a row. P6 shows −69 days of float on project completion and 224 open activities with negative float (238 last week). The three site-completion milestones are now forecast for 09-Mar (Hasa Oasis), 23-Mar (Dammam) and 27-Mar-2027 (Arar), each 7 days later than last week. The weekly report now also gives 29-Mar-2027 as the committed completion date, although no extension of time or change order is recorded. The air dome covers are expected in the Kingdom on 07-Dec-2026, and only if they are sent by air.

Late purchase orders, site furniture and the air dome drive the finish date. The most negative float in P6 (−69 days) sits on the purchase orders and deliveries for pavement markings and marking paint, the track surface delivery, the benches, precast seats, trash bins and traffic signs that follow them, and the final clean-up. Next come the purchase orders for distribution boards and power cables, the padel wire mesh delivery, stamped concrete, furniture and MEP testing of the landscape works (−64 days, ending at Dammam completion). Air dome membrane deliveries now run from 23-Nov-2026 to 14-Jan-2027 and membrane installation from 19-Jan to 11-Feb-2027, with −21 to −54 days of float. MEP testing and commissioning is forecast from 01-Feb to 27-Mar-2027.

Procurement of key materials

Share of total quantity delivered to site for the 29 long-lead items. Source: procurement tracker dated 23-Nov-2026, which matches the Procurement sheet of the weekly report.

The weekly report's procurement summary: 140 materials (119 last week), 119 purchase orders of which 116 issued and 3 still to issue, 104 materials on site and 93 still to arrive. In the tracker, 9 long-lead items are delivered in full and 20 are not delivered, 13 of them for the air dome; four purchase orders (air dome fire-fighting system and doors, precast site furniture and benches) are not issued because the supplier, samples or shop drawings are not approved. Procurement physical progress is 71.3% against 95.2% planned; 150 man-hours were earned this week, all at Arar.

Air dome: nothing deliveredNone of the 13 air dome items has reached site. Most have a 10% advance paid, and the tracker expects them on site between 25-Nov and 01-Dec-2026. The issue log says the covers were shipped by sea from Jeddah to Slovenia on 30-Oct-2026 for welding and are expected in the Kingdom on 07-Dec-2026, provided they are sent by air. P6 places membrane deliveries from 23-Nov-2026 to 14-Jan-2027.
Sports surfaces wait for the air domeThe football turf, padel glass and mesh and the basketball surface are 60% paid, with all layers done except the finishing layer, which the tracker ties to the air dome finishing to avoid damage; they are expected on site on 30-Nov-2026. LV panel boards and the booster pumps are expected on 01-Dec-2026. The fire alarm system arrived on 12-Nov-2026, with its panel still to come.
